## What this changes

<!-- One change per pull request. -->

## For a data correction

- [ ] I can read Pashto, or I have cited a source
- [ ] The old value was wrong because: <!-- one sentence -->
- [ ] Letter forms follow CONTRIBUTING.md (`ی` not `ي` medially, `ک` not `ك`, `ګ` not `گ`, `آ` kept)

## Checks

- [ ] `pytest` passes
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes
- [ ] New behaviour has a test, or this is a data-only change
- [ ] No new runtime dependency

<!-- If a test blocks a change you believe is right, say so here rather than
     working around it. The tests encode one person's judgement about Pashto
     and that judgement can be wrong. -->
